summary: The registrant, KKR Private Equity Conglomerate LLC, filed an 8-K disclosing the continuous private offering of new share series (Class I-Series 2, 3, and 4) to accredited investors under Section 4(a)(2) and Rule 506(b). The filing also covers amendments to the management agreement with KKR DAV Manager LLC and a dealer-manager agreement with KKR Capital Markets LLC. No specific price, premium, or material transaction terms are stated. This is a routine continuous offering and internal restructuring of share classes, not a transformative special situation.
